name: 3 IN 1 EMS Face Lifting Massager Neck Firming Eye Massage Skin Fine Lines Beauty Tools Skin Lifting Tightening Device Skin Care Tool
description:
Type: Face Lifting Massager 
Material: ABS 
Battery: 1*AA Battery 
Output Power: 1.2W 
Output voltage: DC 1.5V 0.18A 
Replacement Head: Neck/Eyes/Face 
3 Massage Heads: 3 massage heads to meet your different skin care needs. Take care of your face, neck and eye lifting to make your skin healthier. 
Ergonomic Design: Designed according to ergonomics and physiological curves of the neck, eyes and face, the shape is comfortable and the skin becomes flat and firm during pushing and pulling. 
Anti-wrinkle & Anti-aging: EMS microcurrent, photorejuvenation, impacting the bottom layer of the skin, promoting blood circulation, making your creams, serums and lotions work faster and better, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. 
Home Beauty Salon: Professional massage techniques allow you to enjoy neck beauty, rechargeable design is easy to use and carry.
